acceptance_criteria.statement: Implement durable signal and timer waits has executable implementation and behavior-specific automated verification.

description: Implement durable signal and timer waits. This Pass 13 task implements and locally verifies the bounded durable-orchestration scope while preserving truthful external backend qualification state.
exclusions: No live durable backend qualification is claimed.
No active workflow history is silently migrated between durable backends.
objective: Implement durable signal and timer waits
observability_impact: Workflow transitions, retries, waits, checkpoints, heartbeats, operations, and recovery decisions are structured and queryable.
rationale: Durable workflow execution must survive restart and worker loss without allowing a workflow provider to become canonical project authority or permitting blind retries of uncertain external effects.
rollback_recovery_consideration: Preserve append-only events/checkpoints/recovery decisions; revert adapter/configuration changes without rewriting prior workflow history.
security_impact: Durable execution uses stable identities, fencing, policy-bounded external adapters, and explicit uncertain-outcome reconciliation.
title: Implement durable signal and timer waits
